summary.text: William Clifford is a Republican who represents Kansas Senate District 39 in Finney County and has served in the Senate since 2025, after serving in the Kansas House from 2021 to 2024.
He is vice chair of the Public Health and Welfare Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Kansas Legislature profile, Clifford's spouse is Jean Clifford.

He is also a member of the Federal and State Affairs, Local Government, Transparency and Ethics, and Utilities committees, the Senate Select Committee on Veterans Affairs, and special committees on health and social services, pharmaceutical studies and the Kansas Board of Emergency Medical Services.
